mapper.select:
select a.name label, a.code from iot_product a
and device_type != 'Gateway'
order by a.device_type asc, create_time desc

select a.name label, a.field code from iot_model_attr a left join iot_product b on a.product_id = b.id where b.code = #{productCode} and data_type != 'json' and b.id is not null order by a.create_time desc
select name label, id code from iot_device_group order by create_time desc

select a.name label, a.uid code from iot_device a
left join iot_product p on a.product_id = p.id where p.code = #{productCode}
select count(1) total, count(if(status = 'enabled', 1, null)) start from iot_product
select count(1) total, count(if(status = 'start', 1, null)) start from iot_gateway
